verdict.rationale: Vercel's access-token docs say every token carries a scope at the personal, team or project level. A project-scoped token denies requests to any other project, user-level or team-level resource, explicitly to keep jobs, tools and workflows constrained to what they need. That covers the least-privilege credential need for agents. Missing for 10: action-level permissions (e.g. read-only vs. deploy), token expiry or rotation controls, agent-specific credential issuance (the MCP OAuth metadata advertises only an 'openid' scope), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
